title: Enrolment & Update
text:
You may re-enrol or update your details using the correct documents, ensuring you remain within the permissible update limits. Within 10 days of Aadhaar Number generation or update (except mobile & email updates), Aadhaar letters are printed and handed over to Department of Posts (DoPT). The letters are delivered via first class franking mode to the Aadhaar Number Holders (ANH) according to the timelines specified in the Citizen’s Charter of the Department of Posts, which is available on the India Post website at the following link: 
You may download an e-Aadhaar, order an Aadhaar PVC Card, or use the Aadhaar App. All forms of Aadhaar are equally valid and acceptable. For more information, please refer to the UIDAI circular ([Click here](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Circular_dated_30_09_2020_regarding_Aadhaar_PVC_Card.pdf))
